description: Exact unit conversion with dimensional analysis (NIST SP 811) — Converts up to 100 values between units for an agent that needs the exact factor and a refusal when the units do not match: SI and NIST SP 811 length, mass, time, volume, pressure, energy, power, temperature, with compound expressions like kg*m/s^2. Rejects incompatible dimensions, converts absolute temperatures affinely through kelvin and temperature differences linearly, and converts mass to vol

density.description: Default density for items that cross mass and volume.

unit.description: Mass per volume unit expression, e.g. g/mL, kg/m3, lb/ft3, oz/cup_us.

value.description: Caller-supplied mass per volume. Never looked up: no ingredient density table is shipped.

claimed.description: Optional claimed result in the target unit; a mismatch beyond relTolerance fails with expected vs actual.

density.description: Per-item density, overriding the top-level one. Required to cross mass and volume (cups to grams).

unit.description: Mass per volume unit expression, e.g. g/mL, kg/m3, lb/ft3, oz/cup_us.

value.description: Caller-supplied mass per volume. Never looked up: no ingredient density table is shipped.

from.description: Unit expression: symbols, SI prefixes, * / ^ and parentheses, e.g. m/s^2, kg*m/s2, degF, cup_us, lb/ft3. Bare cup/tbsp/tsp/gal/pt/qt/floz/cal/hp/ton are ambiguous and answer unknown with the candidates.

kind.description: absolute (default): a temperature reading, converted affinely through kelvin. difference: a temperature interval, converted linearly.

value.description: A finite number, or a decimal string when the digits must stay exact ("236.5882365"). Magnitude at most 1e15.

precision.description: Significant digits of the reported value. Default 12.

name: unit-convert
